title: Where I have shipped real things.

items.overview: UI Health runs healthcare services and academic programs that depend on schedules, faculty details, residency data, and events being accurate across internal systems and public-facing platforms. I build web applications and integration workflows that keep clinical and academic information reliable for patients, staff, and students.
responsibilities: Designing and implementing a scalable content sync system for faculty, residency, and scheduling data across internal systems and CMS platforms.
Using REST APIs, validation, retry logic, and MCP-based tools to support controlled AI-assisted workflows and reduce manual updates.
Building and maintaining React applications for clinical workflows such as appointment scheduling and academic workflows such as residency training.
Handling inconsistent data through validation, transformation, secure API usage, logging, error handling, and retry-safe execution.
Documenting architecture and data flows to support scalability, maintainability, and faster onboarding.
Maintaining WCAG accessibility compliance, performance, and cross-browser reliability across all pages.

items.overview: LPS Health is a cardiovascular health and wellness platform focused on preventive care and education. The organization needed reliable digital workflows for events, seminars, donations, and engagement, so I led a full-cycle website rebuild within a three-month internship.
responsibilities: Led a full-cycle website rebuild within a three-month timeline, delivering production-ready features for event registrations, seminars, and donations.
Implemented end-to-end user and payment workflows with Stripe Checkout, including validation and error handling for secure, reliable transactions.
Managed CI/CD pipelines through GitHub and Netlify to automate build and deployment processes.
Optimized frontend performance through Lighthouse audits and efficient data handling, reducing redundant API calls and improving responsiveness.
Added basic Jest tests and validation logic to keep core user flows stable.
Collaborated with stakeholders to define requirements and iterated using Google Analytics insights to improve engagement and conversion.

items.overview: Oracle Fusion Cloud builds enterprise applications that support large-scale business operations. I contributed to Berkshire Hathaway Energy platforms across BHE-HCM for payroll, scheduling, employee records, and absence management, and BHE-CX Services for field service, work orders, asset maintenance, and inspections.
responsibilities: Contributed to production-grade enterprise applications as part of an Agile Scrum team for BHE-HCM and BHE-CX platforms.
Designed and built Redwood-style dashboards, forms, and workflow interfaces using Oracle Visual Builder Studio integrated with Oracle Fusion REST APIs.
Engineered API integration layers with data mapping, validation, and error handling to keep data consistent across distributed systems.
Implemented secure development practices including input validation and role-based access considerations.
Collaborated with backend, QA, and product teams to deliver features and support production releases.
Improved maintainability through structured code reviews, modular component design, and consistent documentation.
Diagnosed and resolved 100+ production bugs across UI and API layers, and contributed to Jest test coverage for UI behavior and API interactions.
Received an Employee Recognition Award for rapidly mastering Oracle VBS and being selected to support the BHE-HCM product team.
